description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ByPreMadeFilterInterpreter' within the SuiteCRM JSON API filtering module. It specifies method signatures for checking the presence of a filter and retrieving filter data, serving as a contract for implementing classes related to pre-made filter interpretation.

classes.name: ByPreMadeFilterInterpreter
classes.description: An interface declaring methods for interpreting pre-made filters in the SuiteCRM JSON API filter system.

methods.name: hasByPreMadeFilter
methods.description: Checks if a pre-made filter identified by $name exists.

methods.name: getByPreMadeFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the filter data or identifier for a pre-made filter.
